temp.label: Mean temperature
temp.say: the mean temperature of the year, averaged over the place

tempMax.label: Mean daily high
tempMax.say: the mean of each day's highest temperature in the year

tempMin.label: Mean daily low
tempMin.say: the mean of each day's lowest temperature in the year

precip.label: Precipitation
precip.say: rain and snow in the year, in millimetres of water

co2.label: CO₂ emitted
co2.say: carbon dioxide emitted from fossil fuels and industry in the year, in millions of tonnes

co2PerHead.label: CO₂ per person
co2PerHead.say: carbon dioxide emitted from fossil fuels and industry in the year, in tonnes per person

hottestDay.label: Hottest day
hottestDay.say: the year's highest daily temperature at each place, averaged over the country

coldestNight.label: Coldest night
coldestNight.say: the year's lowest daily temperature at each place, averaged over the country

hotDays.label: Days above 35 °C
hotDays.say: days in the year whose high passed 35 °C, at each place, averaged over the country

tropicalNights.label: Nights above 20 °C
tropicalNights.say: nights in the year whose low stayed above 20 °C, at each place, averaged over the country

frostDays.label: Frost days
frostDays.say: days in the year whose low fell below 0 °C, at each place, averaged over the country

wettestDay.label: Wettest day
wettestDay.say: the year's most rain in one day at each place, averaged over the country

heavyRainDays.label: Days of 20 mm or more
heavyRainDays.say: days in the year with 20 mm of rain or more, at each place, averaged over the country

drySpell.label: Longest dry spell
drySpell.say: the year's longest run of days with under 1 mm of rain, at each place, averaged over the country

pm25.label: Fine-particle pollution (PM2.5)
pm25.say: people's mean exposure over the year to fine particles, PM2.5, in micrograms per cubic metre of air

pm25AboveWho.label: People above the WHO guideline
pm25AboveWho.say: the share of people exposed to more fine-particle pollution than the World Health Organization's guideline

aqiGood.label: Good days
aqiGood.say: days of the year the Air Quality Index was good (0-50)

aqiSensitive.label: Unhealthy for sensitive groups
aqiSensitive.say: days it was unhealthy for sensitive groups (101-150)

aqiMedian.label: Median Air Quality Index
aqiMedian.say: the median of the year's daily Air Quality Index readings

aqiMax.label: Highest Air Quality Index
aqiMax.say: the year's highest daily Air Quality Index reading

cru.label: World Bank - Climate Change Knowledge Portal (CRU TS 4.09)
cru.note: The Climatic Research Unit's gridded record of the world's weather stations, half a degree square, averaged over the country by the World Bank.

era5.label: World Bank - Climate Change Knowledge Portal (ERA5 extremes)
era5.note: ERA5, the Copernicus Climate Change Service's reanalysis of the world's weather since 1950, a quarter of a degree square: each place's own extreme for the year - its hottest day, its frost days - averaged over the country by the World Bank. Not the single hottest reading anywhere in it.

wbpm.label: World Bank - World Development Indicators (PM2.5 air pollution)
wbpm.note: People's mean exposure over the year to fine particles, and the share above the WHO guideline, as the World Bank publishes them from the Global Burden of Disease's estimates.
